_about: The tables and views in schema aa that another repo writes from an outside source (D154). The ONE list: proxy/server.js refuses writes to them and labels them, scripts/admin_page.py groups and labels them, scripts/apply_entries.py refuses entries files that touch them (all three through src/ds_aa_tracking/mirrors.py or the same reading of this file), and the publish run warns about any aa table that neither schema.py nor this file describes. A table whose name starts with one of the prefixes is a mirror too, listed or not.
refresh: every day from 05:30 UTC (Databricks job "CERF Supplement Daily")
fix: Wrong values are fixed at the source, or in ds-cerf-supplement for the storm and drought matches: a change made here would be overwritten on the next refresh.

tables.cerf_allocation: CERF allocations, copied from the CERF OneGMS allocations feed
tables.cerf_project: CERF projects, copied from the CERF OneGMS project feed
tables.cerf_project_sector: CERF project amounts by sector, copied from the CERF OneGMS project feed
tables.cerf_project_country: CERF project budgets by country (regional projects), copied from the CERF OneGMS project feed
tables.cerf_contribution: Donor contributions to CERF, copied from the CERF OneGMS contributions feed
tables.cerf_supplement: Storm and drought dating of CERF allocations, written by the ds-cerf-supplement matchers (not a copy of a feed)
tables.cerf_allocation_storm: Links from CERF allocations to the storms they responded to, written by the ds-cerf-supplement storm matcher (not a copy of a feed)
tables.cbpf_allocation: Pooled-fund (CBPF and regional fund) allocations, copied from the CBPF OData API
tables.cbpf_fund: The pooled funds (CBPFs and regional funds), copied from the CBPF OData API
tables.cbpf_project: Pooled-fund projects, copied from the CBPF OData API
tables.cbpf_project_cluster: Pooled-fund project budgets by cluster, copied from the CBPF OData API
tables.cbpf_project_subip: Sub-implementing partners of pooled-fund projects, copied from the CBPF OData API
tables.cbpf_contribution: Donor contributions to the pooled funds by fiscal year, copied from the CBPF OData API

prefixes.cbpf_: A pooled-fund (CBPF) table that this list does not describe yet

views.v_allocation: CERF and pooled-fund allocations in one list, made by ds-cerf-supplement over its allocation mirrors
views.v_contribution: CERF and pooled-fund donor contributions in one list, made by ds-cerf-supplement over its contribution mirrors
